messages:
maria_release: Heads-up: planning to promote multi-arch images (amd64 + arm64) for private-vpc bundles to prod tonight 23:00 UTC. Need checksum + cosign sanity, mirror sync, and a clear fallback plan. Deploy-bot will handle index promotion.

sanjay_packaging: ack. building OCI manifests and index now. rolling tag will be private-vpc-v1.7.3-multiarch

kate_sre: what’s the canary window? I want a 30m canary on the dedicated pools to validate runtime and unpacking in airgapped nodes.

maria_release: canary 23:00-23:30 UTC. full rollout at 23:40 if metrics look good. Fallback triggers: >0.5% 5xx on canary or latency >2x baseline.

lucas_eng: checksum outputs from builder: 
```
sha256(amd64.tar.gz)=abc1234d9e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
sha256(arm64.tar.gz)=def4567a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234
```
cosign sigs pushed to sigstore; KMS key used: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/promote-key. verifying now.

sanjay_packaging: note: airgap delta payload ~420MB per arch. recommend pre-seeding mirror replicas before 22:00 UTC so mirrors can serve immediately.

kate_sre: if canary fails we pin back to private-vpc-v1.7.2 (immutable) and revoke the v1.7.3 index. manual ops approval required to rollback.

maria_release: ops: @deploy-bot please schedule: `promote --index private-vpc-v1.7.3 --targets=mirror1,mirror2 --window=23:00-23:40` and post progress here.

deploy-bot: @maria_release scheduled promote job created: job_id=promote-1769875432. will post statuses in-thread. :gear:

ops-ci: preflight checks done: mirrors reachable, disk free >200GB each, cosign sigs verify OK, image manifest platform entries present for amd64 + arm64. md5 vs sha256 mismatch check passed.

lucas_eng: quick ops note: add a tag-freeze for model-serving images at 23:45 to avoid runtime image drift during teardown.

kate_sre: canary fleet allocation: canary-dedicated-pool-3, capacity=10 pods, healthcheck path `/hc?fast`. will watch CPU/mem + unpack errors.

maria_release: final ask: if we see image unpack failures on airgap nodes, abort and hold; do NOT auto-rollback unless 5xx threshold breached. manual ops call required to coordinate image re-publish.

sanjay_packaging: ack. keeping staging artifact available for hotfix rebuild for 60m post-rollout.

deploy-bot: promote job started -> staging -> mirror1 sync complete (23:06 UTC). mirror2 queued.

kate_sre: monitoring: collecting canary metrics and logs. will post summary after 30m. :eyes:

(30m later)

kate_sre: canary OK. latency stable, error rate 0.08%. no unpack failures in canary fleet. recommend proceed with remainder.

deploy-bot: promote job progressed: mirror2 sync complete; index switched to rolling tag private-vpc-v1.7.3 at 23:42 UTC. :rocket:

maria_release: thanks team. leaving artifact retention window at 6h for a quick revert window. will keep watch on metrics until 07:00 UTC.

ops-ci: retention noted. rollback playbook created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/rollback-1769875432 (contains abort steps, revoke index, tag pin steps, and KMS revoke guidance).

sanjay_packaging: FYI I built an emergency patch branch `private-vpc/v1.7.3-hotfix` in case we need a micro rebuild.

deploy-bot: promote job complete. job_id=promote-1769875432 status=success

kate_sre: follow-up: saw a transient unzip warning on one arm node during unpack (kernel minor mismatch). filed internal bug PRV-982. not blocking the rollout but worth watching.

maria_release: closing thread; thanks. I’ll keep an eye on logs and will escalate if anything spikes. ping me directly for hotfix coordination. :white_check_mark:
